key_features: COMPLETE BACK TO SCHOOL SUPPLY KIT FOR STUDENTS: Prepare students for a successful school year with this complete 70-piece back-to-school supplies kit designed for Middle School and High School students (Grades 7-12). Includes essential classroom supplies for note-taking, homework, assignments, projects, studying, and staying organized throughout the school year.

WHAT'S INCLUDED – ORGANIZATION ESSENTIALS: This student supply bundle includes 6x Assorted Color 2-Pocket Portfolios, 3x Clear Front Report Covers with Sliding Bar, 10x Sheet Protectors, 150x Sheets Wide-Ruled Filler Paper, 1x 10-Color Tab Binder Divider Set, and 1x Black 1" 3-Ring View Binder with Pockets to organize papers, assignments, notes, and important documents.

WRITING & STUDY SUPPLIES INCLUDED: Includes 1x Neon Sticky Notes Pad, 2x Mechanical Pencils, 2x Retractable Cushion Grip Pens, 2x Fluorescent Highlighters, 2x Fine Tip Permanent Markers, 1x Pack of 100 Ruled Index Cards, 1x 1-Subject Spiral Notebook, and 2x Composition Books for writing, studying, note-taking, homework, and everyday classroom activities.

CLASSROOM & MATH ESSENTIALS INCLUDED: Complete the student organization kit with 1x Compass & Protractor Set, 1x Stapler Set, 1x Correction Fluid, and 1x 12" Ruler with Multiplication Table. These classroom essentials support math assignments, projects, labeling, measuring, and daily schoolwork.

PERFECT FOR SCHOOL, HOMESCHOOL & CLASSROOM USE: Ideal for Middle School students, High School students, homeschool learners, teachers, classrooms, school supply drives, and educational programs. Save time and money by getting essential school supplies together in one convenient pre-packed bundle. (Contents, colors, brands, and packaging may vary depending on inventory availability.)
review_summary: The first day of middle school or high school can feel overwhelming, but being prepared changes everything. This school supplies kit helps students walk into class confident, organized, and ready to learn from the moment the bell rings.
